title: Homotheties by elements of the multiplicative set are universally injective, and so is the localization map, over a local Artinian-flavoured flat base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma refines the homothety situation over a local base: under the local homomorphism, finite presentation and flatness hypotheses, every element of the multiplicative set acts universally injectively and so does the localization map (statement lines 1820-1834, tag 05DF). The proof extracts a short exact sequence with flat quotient from an algebra lemma, converts flatness into universal injectivity, and passes to the directed colimit. The transport from flatness to universal injectivity is the substance, so the claim is H2.
